# National VLA Recipients

Asterisks (*) are used to denote those who received their Venturing Leadership
Award for their service to the Sea Scouting program. Starting in 2017, the new
Sea Scout Leadership Award will instead be used to recognize outstanding
individuals in that program.

### Youth Recipients

**2023**

Kaitlyn Bishop (NST 12)
